newsitem.title: FRANCE: French govt to take Thomson decisions in weeks.
newsitem.headline: French govt to take Thomson decisions in weeks.

text.p: The French government will put into place in the next few weeks its plans for defence electronics company Thomson-CSF, a statement from Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's office said on Friday.
It said it had decided to cancel the privatisation of Thomson-CSF and would seek to build a French defence electronics pillar. The state would retain a controlling stake.
"This plan will be put into place in the next few weeks," the statement said.
The sale of Thomson-CSF was launched by the previous centre-right government, which was defeated by a Socialist-led alliance in a parliamentary election in June.
